code:
This project replaced a day-stale manual export and zero
real-time visibility with a platform both Operations and
Support genuinely use -- and fixed a real bug along the way.

It did not add production alerting beyond CI, a guarantee
the batch and real-time paths never diverge during a replay,
or protection for the scanner fleet and Kafka itself -- named
gaps for a future phase, not oversights we're pretending don't exist.
caption: Not every problem solved -- every remaining one named, owned, and handed off.

subtitle: Twenty videos, one real platform, both teams actually using it -- bugs and all.
